name: PlasBit Plastic Card
summary: PlasBit Card stands out as a practical crypto card for everyday spending, letting users load crypto, convert it to fiat, and pay online, in stores, or withdraw from ATMs. With free virtual and plastic cards, free delivery, and only a 0.5% loading fee, it is built for people who actually use crypto in daily life

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the PlasBit Plastic Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$1 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the PlasBit Plastic Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 1.5% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the PlasBit Plastic Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
